overview: At Henley Street you set down the afternoon walk down Chapel Street with Anne and Richard past the three-storey brick-and-timber corner house — broken pane, nettles at the gate, sound framing, the garden Anne knew what she would do with — asking no price, asking Anne for three years, and hearing she will give you till she believes you.

parties.name: William Shakespeare
parties.context: Recorded the afternoon walk down Chapel Street and his three-year promise to Anne.

parties.name: Anne Shakespeare
parties.context: Looked into the garden behind the gate and said she will give him till she believes him.

parties.name: Richard Shakespeare
parties.context: Tapped the wall with his stick and judged the framing sound.

important_dates.meaning: Chapel Street Walk — The Brick and Timber House

summary: Noted the brick-and-timber house on Chapel Street
